newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police arrest four after ethnic clashes.
newsitem.headline: S.African police arrest four after ethnic clashes.

text.p: South African police said on Wednesday four suspects were arrested by a special investigation team set up to look into ethnic clashes at a platinum mine northwest of Johannesburg at the weekend which killed 32 people.

"Four suspects were arrested and will appear...in court today on charges of theft and arson," police in North West Province said in a statement. They did not say whether the men could also be linked to the killings.

Fighting broke out at a squatter camp called Freedom Park near Impala's Wildebeesfontein mine in Rustenburg on Saturday after a Xhosa-speaking shopowner killed a Sotho man, allegedly for stealing milk from his shop.
Police and soldiers were brought in to keep the two tribal groups apart and no further violence was reported this week.
Mineowners Impala Platinum Holdings said on Tuesday that most of those killed were employed at the mine. Investigations are continuing.
